content.short: Dedaub Security Suite provides comprehensive security for blockchain projects through static analysis, fuzzing, and real-time monitoring of smart contracts.
content.description: The Dedaub Security Suite is a comprehensive toolset that strengthens blockchain project security through advanced static analysis, targeted fuzzing, and high-fidelity real-time monitoring of smart contracts. It supports pre-deployment and post-deployment security checks, can decompile and analyze contracts without public sources or ABI, and identifies and monitors the release of new contracts related to a protocol. It also provides transaction previews before on-chain execution.
content.meta: Dedaub Security Suite is a comprehensive toolset for blockchain security. Discover Dedaub Security Suite and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
